# 1 Clement Chapter 53 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 53 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_053_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 53

**53:1** For you know and know well the sacred Scriptures, beloved, and you have searched carefully through the oracles of God. We write these things, then, to call them to your memory.

**53:2** When Moses ascended the mountain and had spent forty days and forty nights in fasting and self-abasement, God said to him: "Moses, Moses, go down quickly from here, for your people whom you led out of the land of Egypt have transgressed. They have quickly turned aside from the way which you commanded them: they have made molten images for themselves."

**53:3** And the LORD said to him: "I have spoken to you once and again, saying, I have seen this people and behold, they are stiff-necked. Let me utterly destroy them, and I will wipe out their name from under heaven; and I will make you a nation great and wonderful, far more than this one."

**53:4** And Moses said: "By no means, Lord. Forgive this people their sin, or else blot me out as well from the book of the living."

**53:5** O magnificent love! O insuperable perfection! The servant speaks with boldness to the LORD. He asks forgiveness for the multitude, or asks that he himself be blotted out with them.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
